[To [Anne Yonge](people/person_1582.qmd)]

At the Hall[^1] is a beautiful picture of [King Charles](people/person_1768.qmd) the martyr, a full-length, and with the beautiful forehead we always see him drawn with.

---

[^1]: West Dean, near Chichester,  Sussex,  where they were staying with CMY’s godmother [Caroline Vernon Harcourt](people/person_1422.qmd), sister of its owner, Lord Selsey.
